description: Lists the CIVIL NX pictures the Model Report can put in this model's report, with their keys: FE model views (iso, plan, front, side), the applied loads of each static load case, the figures saved in the model (/db/UFIG), and the beam diagrams on offer (each static case, combination and construction-stage part × components Fx…Mw). Pick from them with model_report_export images. Read-only (GET only); nothing is rendered.
name: model_report_images
title: Pictures the model report can carry
